source_binding.confirmed_mechanism: adaptive resource allocation and early stopping; Hyperband runs multiple Successive Halving brackets to vary breadth versus per-configuration resource
source_binding.chat_resource_mapping: one bounded same-scope evidence-probe stage, not money, external API tokens, hosted compute credits or user labor

candidate_pool.instruction: Use stable frontier order, checkpoint the chosen assignment, and continue from that checkpoint.

Run a bounded same-scope evidence probe for each candidate, persist and read back staged scores, resume surviving candidates after interruption, and award semantic credit only after full terminal readback.
Escalate uncertain candidates to an external API or richer execution mode and use that result to choose the winner.
Eliminate low staged scores and immediately credit the current winner before terminal readback.

fatal_gates.rule: No candidate may mutate root/config/CLEAN/authority/quota/cost fields.
No accepted candidate may require external API/model, hosted compute, richer-mode, protected-primary or manual-user execution, or finite monthly/trial/paid quota.

incremental_evidence_guards.rule: Candidate defines a bounded switching action.
Candidate persists intermediate choice/state before relying on it.
Candidate requires durable readback before staged evidence affects selection.
Selection/ties are deterministic under equal staged evidence.
Restart resumes surviving candidate state before reselection.
Transport failure is non-semantic and cannot increase/decrease candidate quality score.
Semantic credit is withheld until independent full terminal readback.
Bounded exit preserves exact scope, nonempty frontier and exact continuation.

score_rule: Fatal gate failure => score 0 and eliminate. Otherwise score is PASS count among guards exposed at the current resource stage. Ties use stable lexical candidate id.
